extraction_notes: No tables in the paper report PDH performance values. Performance was extracted from plotted figures. The reported y-axis quantity named “Activity (µmol_C3H8·m^-2·s^-1)” is a surface-area-normalized propane conversion activity, not a propylene formation rate; it was placed in the propylene_rate field only because the schema has no propane-activity field. No propane conversion values, propylene yields, or deactivation constants were printed for these figures. The experimental section states all data were collected from 21 min after steady state; TOS=21 min was therefore applied to initial bar-chart values. Propane fraction in feed was not computed, per instruction not to compute quantities other than molar feed ratios.
